regions.name: Ocean (W strip)
regions.problem: v2 shredded the waterline into salt-and-pepper because fractalize_edge had no spatial coherence; tool now rewritten to move the frontier by a smooth along-coast noise profile (headlands/inlets, not speckle)
regions.intent: clean depth ramp, then coherent meander via the fixed fractalize, then a few patchy wet-beach spots

regions.name: Central sand flat
regions.problem: v2 vegetation still speckly (per-cell); scatter now grows coherent patches
regions.intent: wash + hill + soil hollow retained; vegetation as a few scrub STANDS

regions.name: Rock massif
regions.problem: cave + talus foot already good in v1/v2

regions.name: Gravel outcrops
regions.problem: ruin good; needs a final smooth to hit the fragmentation guardrail
regions.intent: keep ruin; smooth twice at the end

edits.rationale: Water column x0-15 W->E: deep, deep, shallow, sand. No mud in the order.
Rewritten fractalize moves the land/water frontier along the coast by a smooth noise profile, reach 4 - carves headlands and inlets instead of noise.
A few coherent Mud patches on sand right at the waterline x12-19 - wet spots, not a band.
Gravel wash SW->NE through the dead center.
Coherent mossy patches (a handful of stands) over sand only - reads as clumped desert scrub.
Soil catchment at the wash bend (~45,60) - the map's farm start.
Carve solid RockFace core ~(95,92); stays enclosed.
Two majority-smooth passes over non-water families to absorb specks and hit the fragmentation guardrail.

notes: Cave chamber: ancient danger / infestation deep inside.
Ruined structure: slain ancients + salvage (Factory-ship scavenger theme).
Fertile hollow: the farm start; raids approach along the wash.
